analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (Win Championship goal) proposes sending DeVonta Smith (WR, 84.9 C-AVI / 91.9 D-AVI), Tyler Warren (TE, 81.6 C-AVI / 90.0 D-AVI), and a 2027 2nd-round pick (48.5 Pick AVI) to Big Balder Brand for Trey McBride (TE, 93.4 C-AVI / 92.7 D-AVI). While Big Balder Brand would eagerly accept this offer (83% acceptance probability) because it increases their starting lineup output (+14.2 C-AVI) and adds premium assets, the transaction is severely net-negative for Corgi. Upgrading from Tyler Warren to Trey McBride provides a +11.8 C-AVI lift at TE, but losing starting FLEX wideout DeVonta Smith forces David Montgomery into the starting lineup, causing a net starting lineup decline of -18.9 C-AVI for Corgi while destroying WR depth and surrendering draft capital. AVI recommends DECLINING the submitted trade.
